notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the Sky Hussar token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
